reviewedLines: High-Velocity Rounds: Bullet Velocity reduced from 60% to 45% (upgrades unaffected)
Express Shot: Secondary Fire Weapon Damage and growth reduced by 5%
Point Blank: Slow duration increased from 2s to 2.5s
Hunter's Aura: No longer affects or counts enemies outside of line of sight or through walls
Shadow Weave: No longer has Ambush Fire Rate or Melee Damage
Shadow Weave: Now has +50% Ambush Weapon Damage
Shadow Weave: Ambush bonuses now build up over 6s of being stealthed before reaching full power (invis progress UI pulses when it is charged up)
Shadow Weave: Abilities used to break stealth now benefit from the Ambush bonus on their own damage (previously the bonus was applied after the ability had already gone off)
Toxic Bullets: Anti Heal increased from 35% to 40%
Armor Piercer: Chance increased from 55% to 60%
Glass Cannon: Weapon Damage increased from 80% to 85%
Spiritual Overflow: Spirit power increased from 6 to 8 (from component changes)
Crippling Headshot: Anti-Heal increased from -35% to -40%
Golden Goose Egg: Damage Penalty reduced from -15% to -12%
Spirit Sap: Cooldown increased from 18s to 22s
Spirit Sap: Cast range reduced from 40m to 35m
Mystic Slow: Dash Distance slow increased from -10% to -12%
Decay: Incoming Heal reduction increased from -50% to -55%
Radiant Regeneration: Regen on Spirit Damage scaling reduced from 0.35 to 0.25
Radiant Regeneration: Heal on Ability Cast now only triggers when you are in combat (like Spellslinger)
Radiant Regeneration: Heal on Ability Cast reduced from 65 to 40
Radiant Regeneration: Heal on Ability Cast boon scaling reduced from 1.7 to 1.4
Silence Wave: Bonus Health increased from +50 to +90
Torment Pulse: Melee Resistance increased from 18% to 22%
Echo Shard: Post cast time reduced from 0.5s to 0.2s
Focus Lens: Cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s
Focus Lens: Fixed damage dealt to a barrier not counting toward the repeated damage
Lightning Scroll: Damage now scales with Spirit Power (0.35)
Lightning Scroll: Dash Distance slow increased from -10% to -12%
Rebuttal: Parry Cooldown reduction reduced from -1.75s to -1.25s
Battle Vest: Weapon Damage increased from 18% to 22%
Bullet Lifesteal: Weapon Damage increased from 6% to 10%
Bullet Lifesteal: Bullet Lifesteal increased from 13% to 15%
Healbane: Multiple sources now stack on the enemy with diminishing returns (previously didn't stack)
Healbane: Heal on Hero Kill reduced from 275 to 170 + 3/Boon
Healing Booster: No longer builds from Extra Regen
Healing Booster: No longer grants +3 Health Regen
Healing Booster: Out of Combat Regen increased from +1 to +2
Return Fire: Now returns the damage you take from Haze's Fixation
Return Fire: Fixed the shop tooltip not listing the 10% Bullet Resistance
Spirit Lifesteal: Spirit Power increased from 6 to 8
Spirit Lifesteal: Spirit Lifesteal increased from 13% to 15%
Spirit Shielding: Spirit Resist reduced from 18% to 15%
Bullet Resilience: Bullet Resistance increased from 30% to 35%
Bullet Resilience: Out of Combat Regen increased from 3 to 5
Fury Trance: Active Move Speed increased from +1m to +1.5m
Fury Trance: Bullet Lifesteal increased from 14% to 15%
Fury Trance: Weapon Damage increased from 6% to 10%
Healing Nova: Now scales with Spirit Power (1.1) instead of Boons (6)
Metal Skin: Now increases your gravity by 20% while active
Infuser: Active Lifesteal increased from 70% to 75%
Infuser: Spirit Lifesteal increased from 13% to 15%
Infuser: Spirit power increased from 6 to 8
Juggernaut: Health Regen increased from +8 to +15
Leech: Bullet Lifesteal increased from 28% to 30%
Leech: Spirit Lifesteal increased from 28% to 30%
Vampiric Burst: Active Lifesteal increased from 70% to 75%
Vampiric Burst: Bullet Lifesteal increased from 13% to 15%
Vampiric Burst: Weapon Damage increased from 6% to 10%

Spellbreaker: When the item procs, it continues to reduce any other spirit damage that happens as a result in that damage stack (for example, getting hit by charged shot that procs tankbuster now both get reduced)
Divine Barrier: Cooldown increased from 45s to 55s
